description: Facts read from the company's own website: opening hours (per weekday), branches/locations with addresses, offer (CPV divisions plus short product/service names in PL/EN/DE), certifications found on the site (ISO 9001, HACCP, FSC…), website technology (CMS, e-commerce platform, payments, analytics) and clients/partners linked from the site that match KRS companies. Keyed by KRS or NIP (sole proprietors with a public profile); null when the website has not been read or shows none of these.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.
